title: cryptocarya berteroana
intro: Cryptocarya berteroana, commonly known as the Spanish lime or wild lime, is a species of evergreen tree in the family Lauraceae. This plant is native to Hawaii and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Cryptocarya berteroana include its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
